title: If You Want To Be Happy

scenes.narration: If you want to be happy for the rest of your life, learn to love yourself,
scenes.image_query: If you want to be happy for the rest of your life, learn to love yourself,

scenes.narration: learn to prioritize you, learn to say no without feeling guilty,
scenes.image_query: learn to prioritize you, learn to say no without feeling guilty,

scenes.narration: learn to mind your own business, learn not to care too much about everything,
scenes.image_query: learn to mind your own business, learn not to care too much about everything,

scenes.narration: and most importantly, understand that you don't need everybody to like you.
